description:
Search the businesses that take bookings through Gaplessly by name, by suburb or postcode, or by kind, and get back each one's slug, name, kind, address and booking page link. Use this when the guest names a business or an area but you do not have a slug; every other tool needs one.

Send at least one of `name`, `location` or `kind`. Only real businesses that have chosen to be found by assistants are searchable here, so an empty result means "not found here", not that the business does not exist or cannot be booked: ask the guest for its booking link, which works with every other tool. Then call get_venue with the slug.

kind.description: appointments for salons, clinics and studios; hospitality for restaurants, cafes and bars.

limit.description: How many venues to return, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

location.description: A suburb, city or postcode, matched against the venue address, for example "Newtown" or "2042".

name.description: Part of the business name, for example "Saltline". Case does not matter.

name: find_venues
title: Find a venue
